Authenticity 0.3.3.

- **The AI Detector pane no longer jumps while a check is loading.** While a check ran, every update of the pane scrolled back to the row of the checked selection. Now only *Show in AI check* and *Show in similarity check* scroll, once; the pane keeps your scroll position while it updates, and the line that says what is running keeps its height. The Plagiarism pane has the same fix.
- **Reasons fold away.** In the *Why* column, each detector starts collapsed, with its name, its result and its share of the score on one line; open it to read its explanation. *Not counted for this text's language* and *Did not run* are collapsed too.
- **GPTZero's reasons for GPTZero's rows.** A row GPTZero scored shows GPTZero's message and each sentence's probability (collapsed), never SlopTotal's detectors, and an *AI Patterns* button that asks GPTZero for its explanations (for keys GPTZero has allow-listed; it sends that paragraph again).
- **No Hints column.** Authenticity's own writing patterns (stock phrases, vague wording and so on) are rare in academic prose, so the column was mostly empty. When a row has any, they are now a collapsed *Writing patterns* entry in its *Why* cell, and their words are still highlighted in the paragraph.

The helper program and the other native programs are unchanged: keep using the ones from the [native release 0.3.0](https://github.com/Gameboard-dev/authenticity/releases/tag/native-0.3.0).

The plugin's files are `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css`, built by GitHub Actions from this tag and attested: `gh attestation verify main.js --repo Gameboard-dev/authenticity`.
